description: This file implements the ContinueWatching service plugin for the WPEFramework, providing APIs to get, set, and delete application tokens, with encryption/decryption, JSON storage, and RFC configuration checks. It includes classes for general and Netflix-specific token handling.

classes.name: ContinueWatching
classes.description: Main plugin class managing application tokens and API registration.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Base class providing encryption, decryption, JSON storage, and RFC configuration checks.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImplFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create platform-specific ContinueWatchingImpl instances.

classes.name: NetflixContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Derived class implementing token handling specific to Netflix application.

methods.name: getApplicationToken
methods.description: Retrieves the application token for a given application name.

methods.name: setApplicationToken
methods.description: Stores the application token for a given application name.

methods.name: deleteApplicationToken
methods.description: Deletes the stored application token for a given application name.

methods.name: getAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to get token data for an application.

methods.name: setAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to set token data for an application.

methods.name: deleteAppToken
methods.description: Internal method to delete token data for an application.

methods.name: encryptData
methods.description: Encrypts data using SecAPI if enabled.

methods.name: decryptData
methods.description: Decrypts data using SecAPI if enabled.

methods.name: writeToJson
methods.description: Stores encrypted token data into a JSON file.

methods.name: readFromJson
methods.description: Reads encrypted token data from a JSON file.

methods.name: deleteToken
methods.description: Deletes token data from JSON storage.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Generates SHA256 hash of a string.

methods.name: checkTR181
methods.description: Checks RFC parameter for feature enablement.

methods.name: tr181FeatureEnabled
methods.description: Determines if feature is enabled via RFC and environment variable.
